y-m-26-03.title: Kutshintsha ntoni xa kwaziwa ngakumbi ngee-dayagonali?
y-m-26-03.goal: Cacisa, unxulumanisa neemeko, ukuba isigwebo sokuba ikwadrilatharali yinxande okanye likwere sitshintsha njani njengoko ulwazi ngee-dayagonali longezwa enye ngexesha, uze uqinisekise ngemizekelo oyenzayo ukuba ulwazi lokuqala lodwa alwanelanga.
y-m-26-03.material: Ii-dayagonali ezimbini zekwadrilatharali ABCD zi-AC kunye ne-BD. Inxande yikwadrilatharali apho ii-engile ezine zonke ziii-engile engqukuva, irhombhus yikwadrilatharali apho onke amacala amane abobude obufanayo, kwaye ikwere yikwadrilatharali apho ii-engile ezine zonke ziii-engile engqukuva kwaye onke amacala amane abobude obufanayo. Cinga ukuba sele uyazi ukuba 'ikwadrilatharali apho ii-dayagonali ezimbini zihlulana phakathi i-parallelogram'. Zonke iikwadrilatharali zithathwa njengeekwadrilatharali ezinamacala aphumileyo (iikwadrilatharali ezingenanxalenye ingena ngaphakathi).
y-m-26-03.thinking.0: Ukugweba ngolwazi olungaphelelanga uze uphucule xa kufika ulwazi olutsha
y-m-26-03.prereq.0: Intsingiselo ye-parallelogram, inxande, irhombhus, nekwere, neempawu zee-dayagonali zazo (inqanaba lebanga le-8)
y-m-26-03.prereq.1: Phakathi kweemeko ze-parallelogram, 'ii-dayagonali ezimbini zihlulana phakathi'
y-m-26-03.prereq.2: Umgama phakathi kwamachaphaza amabini kwiplani yekhowudinethi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.prompt: Kwikwadrilatharali ABCD, ulwazi ngee-dayagonali AC ne-BD lutyhilwa kunye ngelinye ixesha. Ixesha ngalinye, gweba 'ukuba ingathiwa yinxande'. (Akukho mfanekiso.)
y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.0: Phinda ubhale ulwazi ngalunye njengempawu 'zee-dayagonali' zekwadrilatharali uze uzithelekise neempawu zee-dayagonali zenxande, i-parallelogram, nerhombhus.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.hint.1: Emva kokuqokelela lonke ulwazi olwaziwayo ukuza kuthi ga ngoku, zoba ukuhlola ukuba ikwadrilatharali egcwalisa lonke olo lwazi kwaye ingeyiyo inxande iyakwazeka na.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Phakathi kweekwadrilatharali ezineedayagonali ezilinganayo, ezinye azizizo iinxande (umzekelo, itrapheziyam enemilenze emibini yobude obufanayo). Ngoko olu lwazi lodwa alunakukwenza uqiniseke ukuba yinxande. Jonga ulwazi olulandelayo uphucule isigwebo sakho.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Yinxande. Kuba inxande inee-dayagonali zobude obufanayo
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Ukuba yinxande, ii-dayagonali ziyalingana' kunye 'nokuba ii-dayagonali ziyalingana, yinxande' ziya kumacala ahlukeneyo. Ukuba okuchaseneyo kukwabambe kufuneka kusetyenzwe ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Awunakuqinisekisa ukuba yinxande. Kubonakala ukuba zikho iikwadrilatharali ezingezizo iinxande nokuba ii-dayagonali ziyalingana
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Unokuzoba ikwadrilatharali enobude beedayagonali kuphela obulinganayo. Ukuba ikho nanye, awunakuqinisekisa.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Ayiyo inxande. Kuba akukho nto ithi ziyahlulana phakathi
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Isenokuba yinxande. 'Akukho nto ithi ziyahlulana phakathi' kunye 'azihlulani phakathi' kwahlukile.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ulwazi aluneleyo, ngoko asikwazi ukuxela ngoku. Isenokuba yinxande okanye ingabi yiyo
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olutsha: ii-dayagonali ezimbini ziyahlulana phakathi. (Ukuba indawo yokunqumla yee-dayagonali yi-O, ngoko AO = CO, BO = DO) Ulwazi lwangaphambili (AC = BD) lusaqhubeka.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Ingaba ngoku ikwadrilatharali ABCD ingathiwa yinxande?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Ukuba ii-dayagonali ziyahlulana phakathi, yi-parallelogram. Kwi-parallelogram ABCD, ukuthelekisa unxantathu ABD nonxantathu DCA, AB = DC, AD = DA (iqhelekile), BD = CA, ngoko bayahambelana (SSS), kwaye ∠A = ∠D. Kuba AB ∥ DC, ∠A + ∠D = 180°, ngoko ∠A = ∠D = 90°. Ngoko yinxande.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Sinokwazi kuphela ukuba yi-parallelogram kwaye sisengazi ukuba yinxande na
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kuchanekile ukuba yi-parallelogram. Kodwa unokuqhubeka usebenzisa i-'AC = BD' oyaziyo ekuqaleni. Kutshintsha ntoni xa usebenzisa ulwazi olubini kunye?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ukuze ibe yirombhasi udinga ulwazi lokuba amacala amane alinganayo. Ukuza kuthi ga ngoku akukho lwazi lobude bamacala.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inxande. Yiparalelogram iidayagonali zayo ezimbini ezinobude obufanayo, ngoko ii-engile ezine ziba zilinganayo
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ikwere. Kuba iidayagonali ziyahlulana zibe ngamaqhekeza alinganayo
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ukuze ibe yikwere, udinga ulwazi olongezelelweyo lokuba amacala amane alinganayo. Ukwahlulwa kokulingana kodwa kukuxelela ukuya kuthi ga kwiparalelogram kuphela.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Okokugqibela okufundiweyo: iidayagonali ezimbini zidibana ngokuthe nkqo. (AC ⊥ BD)
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Ukuyidibanisa nolwazi lonke lwangaphambili, liliphi igama elineenkcukacha ezininzi ze-ABCD?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Kwikwadrilatharali apho iidayagonali ziyahlulana zibe ngamaqhekeza alinganayo, ukuba iidayagonali zithe nkqo, yirombhasi (amacala amane alinganayo). Yayiyinxande sele, ngoko zonke ii-engile ezine ziithe nkqo yaye onke amacala amane alinganayo, ngoko yikwere. 'Inxande' yenyathelo langaphambili isalungile, kodwa ulwazi olutsha lwenze igama laba nenkcazelo ngakumbi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Irombhasi ayilogama elingalunganga nalo (ziyahlulana zibe ngamaqhekeza alinganayo yaye zithe nkqo). Kodwa ukuba udibanisa nolwazi lwenyathelo langaphambili lokuba yinxande, likho igama elineenkcukacha ezininzi.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ukuthi inxande akungalunganga. Kodwa awusebenzisanga 'ethe nkqo' efunyenwe ngeli xesha. Yintoni iparalelogram eneedayagonali ezithe nkqo?
y-m-26-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Ufunde kwinyathelo langaphambili ukuba yinxande. Ulwazi olutsha alunakubuyisa isigqibo sangaphambili.
y-m-26-03.s.s1.reflect: Cinga ukuba kutheni ulwazi lokuqala (ubude beedayagonali obulinganayo) lodwa lungakwenzanga uqiniseke ukuba yinxande, lwongeza ntoni ulwazi lwesibini, nokuba ulwazi lokugqibela lutshintshe okanye lwongeza kwisigqibo sangaphambili.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.prompt: Masizihlole ngokwethu ukuba xa kuphela ulwazi lokuqala (AC = BD) olwaziwayo, inokungabi yinxande. Beka u-A(0, 0) no-B(6, 0), uze wenze iikwadrilatharali ezi-2 ezahlukeneyo ezigoqekileyo ABCD apho iidayagonali AC kunye BD zinobude obufanayo yaye zingeziparalelogram. (Ii-coordinates zamachaphazelo C no-D)
y-m-26-03.s.s2.hint.0: Misela ichaphazelo elinye C uze ufune apho ichaphazelo D linokuba khona umgama walo ukusuka ku-B ulingana 'nomgama ukusuka ku-A ukuya ku-C'.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.hint.1: Zoba ikwadrilatharali ngamachaphazelo owakhethileyo uze uhlole nokuba amacala AB no-DC ayahambelana kwaye amacala AD no-BC ayahambelana.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Ii-y-coordinates zika-C no-D kufuneka zibe ngaphezulu kuka-0 (ngaphezulu kwe-AB).
y-m-26-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Yikwadrilatharali egoqekileyo edibanisa u-A, B, C, D ngocwangciso.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Ukuba udibanisa u-A, B, C, D ngocwangciso, yikwadrilatharali engenayo okanye ewelana. Khetha amachaphazelo kwakhona ukuze ibe yikwadrilatharali apho ii-engile zayo zonke ezine zingaphantsi kwe-180°.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Ubude be-AC no-BD abulingani. Bala ubude beedayagonali ezimbini ngokwahlukileyo uze uzithelekise.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.fail.c4: Le kwadrilatharali yiparalelogram (kubandakanya inxande). Yenza umzekelo ongeyiyo iparalelogram.
y-m-26-03.s.s2.explain: Umzekelo, ukuba C(5, 3) no-D(1, 3), ngoko AC² = 34 kunye BD² = 25 + 9 = 34 (itrapezoyidi enemilenze emibini enobude obufanayo). Ukuba C(4, 3) no-D(3, 4), ngoko AC = BD = 5 kodwa akukho macala amabini ahambelanayo. Zombini zineedayagonali ezilinganayo kodwa azizinxande. Ngoko awukwazi ukuqiniseka ngobude beedayagonali kuphela.

y-m-26-06.title: Singazalisa njani indawo ejikeleze ichaphazelo ngokuxuba amapholigoni aqhelekileyo?
y-m-26-06.topic: Ii-engile zangaphakathi zamapholigoni aqhelekileyo nee-engile ezijikeleze ichaphazelo
y-m-26-06.goal: Dibanisa i-engile enye yangaphakathi yepholigoni eqhelekileyo ne-360° yee-engile ezijikeleze ichaphazelo ukufumana indibaniselwano ezininzi ezihambelana nemeko, uze ucacise indlela yokuzifumana ngaphandle kokushiya nayiphi na nokuba le meko ithetha ngencopho enye.
y-m-26-06.material: Indawo yokwenza iithayile ifuna ukusebenzisa iithayile zonxantathu olinganayo, ikwere, nehegzagoni eqhelekileyo. Zonke iithayile zinobude bomphetho obufanayo, ngoko zinokudityaniswa ngqo icala nelinye. Kulo msebenzi, uyalinganisa kuphela, xa iithayile ezininzi ziqokelelwe encopheni enye, ukuba ii-engile ezijikeleze eso sikhewu zenza i-360° ngqo ngaphandle kwezikhewu okanye ukugqitha. Ukuba oku kunokugubungela umhlaba wonke ayithethwa ngayo.

y-m-26-01.title: Ukuba uyazi amacala amabini ne-engile enye, unxantathu umiselwe njengomnye na?
y-m-26-01.topic: Iimeko zokuhambelana konxantathu (amacala amabini ne-engile enye)
y-m-26-01.goal: Bonisa ngokwenza imizekelo echasayo ukuba ibango elithi 'amacala amabini ne-engile enye ziyalingana' linokungasebenzi ngokuxhomekeke kwindawo ene-engile, uze ugqibe ukuba yintoni eyongezelelekileyo efunekayo ukuqinisekisa ukuba oonxantathu bayahambelana.
y-m-26-01.material:
'UJihu uthe, "Kunxantathu ABC nonxantathu DEF, ukuba AC=DF=10cm, BC=EF=6.5cm, kwaye ∠A=∠D, ngoko oonxantathu aba bobabini bayahambelana!"

Ukuze sikwazi ukuvavanya, ndibeke unxantathu ABC kwiplani yekhowudinethi (ikwere elinye li-1cm). A yimvelaphi (0, 0) kwaye C yi-(8, 6). Ngoko AC=10cm. B yichaphaza kwi-eksisi ye-x, ekunene ka-A (ikhowudinethi yayo ye-x ilungile). ∠A yi-engile eyenziwe licandelo lomgca AB kwi-eksisi ye-x nelicandelo lomgca AC. Sinokubeka unxantathu DEF ngendlela efanayo ukuze AC=DF kwaye ∠A=∠D. Ngoku fumana ichaphaza B elinoBC=6.5cm.'

y-m-26-02.s.s1.prompt: USeohyeon ubhale oku kulandelayo, ethi ubonisa 'ii-engile ezimbini zesiseko sonxantathu onamacala alinganayo ziyalingana ngobungakanani'. Khetha umgca onzima ukwamkelwa njengobungqina.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kumgca ngamnye, phawula ukuba usebenzisa 'oko kunikiweyo (ingcinga ngqo)' okanye 'oko kufuneka kubonakaliswe (isiphelo)'.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.hint.1: Hlela izinto ezintathu kumgca wesi-3 ube yingcinga ngqo, into efunyenwe kumgca wangaphambili, okanye oko bekufuneka kubonakaliswe.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.1: Vumela M libe yindawo ephakathi yecala BC uze udibanise A no-M ngecandelo lomgca. Ngoko BM = CM.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.2: Kunxantathu ABM nonxantathu ACM, AB = AC, ∠B = ∠C (ii-engile zesiseko zonxantathu onamacala alinganayo), kwaye AM iqhelekile.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.3: Ngoko unxantathu ABM nonxantathu ACM bayahambelana.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.line.4: Kunxantathu abahambelanayo ii-engile ezihambelanayo ziyalingana ngobungakanani, ngoko ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s1.explain: Kumgca wesi-3, ∠B = ∠C sele ibhaliwe ngokungathi yinyani. Lesosiphelo ubungqina obuthetha ukuthi buyibonise. Ngenxa yoko, ukuhambelana kumgca wesi-4 nako akunasiseko (AB, ∠B, AM azinguwo amacala amabini nee-engile eziphakathi), kwaye umgca wesi-5 uphela ugqiba ngokuphindaphinda oko kwabhalwa ekuqaleni.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukulungisa ubungqina bukaSeohyeon. Xa utshintsha indlela yokubonisa ukuhambelana kumgca wesi-3, khetha zonke iindlela ezenza ubungqina buchanekile.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.0: Kwindlela nganye, hlola ukuba izinto ezintathu ezisetyenzisiweyo zonke ziingcinga ngqo, okanye zilandela ngokuthe ngqo kwindlela ekhethwe ngayo ichaphaza M.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.hint.1: Thelekisa ukuba inalo ifom ehambelana nemeko yokuhambelana (SSS, SAS, RHS). Hlola nokuba ikhona na indlela esebenzisa isiphelo ∠B = ∠C.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.a: Thatha M njengonyawo lomgca ome nkqo ovela ku-A ukuya ku-BC uze uthelekise usebenzisa AB = AC, AM iqhelekile, ∠AMB = ∠AMC = 90°
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.b: Bhala ∠B = ∠C uze wongeze ukuba oku kuchanekile kuba kubonakala njalo kumfanekiso
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.b: Ukubonakala njalo kumfanekiso asiso isiseko sobungqina. Ubungqina bubonisa isizathu sokuba kubonakale njalo.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.c: Thatha M njengechaphaza apho umgca ohlula i-∠A phakathi udibana khona ne-BC uze uthelekise usebenzisa AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM iqhelekile
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.d: Bhala ukuba oonxantathu ABM no-ACM bayahambelana kuba iindawo zabo ziyalingana, uze ubhale ukuba ii-engile ezihambelanayo ziyalingana
y-m-26-02.s.s2.r.d: Nokuba iindawo ziyalingana, imilo inokwahluka (umzekelo, iinxande ezinobubanzi nobude obahlukeneyo). Indawo elinganayo yodwa ayenzi ukuba bahambelane.
y-m-26-02.s.s2.o.e: Thatha M njengendawo ephakathi ye-BC uze uthelekise usebenzisa AB = AC, BM = CM, AM iqhelekile
y-m-26-02.s.s2.explain: e iyahambelana kuba amacala amathathu ayalingana (SSS), c kuba amacala amabini ne-engile ephakathi ziyalingana (SAS), kwaye a kuba i-hayipotenyusi necala elinye elongezelelweyo likanxantathu one-engile engqukuva ziyalingana (RHS). Akukho ndlela ibhala ∠B = ∠C kwangaphambili; zifumana ∠B = ∠C ekuhambelaneni.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.prompt: Bhala umyalezo wokuxelela uSeohyeon. Yithi kutheni ubungqina bokuqala bungenakuthiwa bubonise 'ii-engile zesiseko ziyalingana', ubhale indlela yokulungisa ngenye yeendlela ezingentla.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.hint.0: Qala ubhale kwisivakalisi esinye ukuba yeyiphi kwezi zinto zintathu zibhaliwe kumgca wesi-3 enguyo ekufuneka ibonakaliswe.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.hint.1: Khetha indlela oyithandayo kukhetho olungentla, bhala izinto ezintathu ezisetyenzisiweyo, uze uhlole ukuba zihambelana negama lemeko yokuhambelana.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Kubhalo lwakho, ingaba kucacile 'oko sele kusetyenzisiwe kumgca ongawuphi'?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kwindlela olungise ngayo, ingaba usebenzisa ∠B = ∠C kuphela njengesiphelo?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Kwindlela olungise ngayo, ingaba zonke izinto ezintathu zemeko yokuhambelana ziyanikwa, okanye zivela kwindlela ichaphaza M elikhethwe ngayo?
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.0: Umgca wesi-3 sele usebenzisa ∠B = ∠C. Lesosiphelo ekufuneka sibonakaliswe, ngoko akufuneki sisetyenziswe njengesiseko. Ungalungisa ngokusebenzisa ukuhambelana kwe-SSS nengcinga ngqo AB = AC, BM = CM evela ngenxa yokuba M yindawo ephakathi, kunye ne-AM eqhelekileyo.
y-m-26-02.s.s3.model.1: Izisa i-∠B = ∠C, ekufuneka ibonakaliswe, njengesiseko sokuhambelana kuqala, ngoko ubungqina buya ngeziphaluka. Ukuba uthatha ichaphaza M usebenzisa umgca ohlula i-∠A phakathi usebenzise ukuhambelana kwe-SAS nge-AB = AC, ∠BAM = ∠CAM, AM iqhelekile, akufuneki ucinge i-∠B = ∠C kwangaphambili.

y-m-26-05.title: Singazenza oonxantathu abane-area ye-12 ngeendlela ezininzi?
y-m-26-05.goal: Qonda ukuba imeko yoonxantathu abanesiseko esifanayo ukuba nendawo efanayo bubude, uze ufumane amachaphazelo amaninzi anelisa iimeko zendawo nobukhulu be-engile ngaxeshanye, ucacise isizathu.
y-m-26-05.material: Kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa, vumela ubude bekwere enye bube yi-1cm. Kukho amachaphazelo A(0, 0) no-B(6, 0), yaye ichaphazelo P liphezu kwe-x-axis. Ufuna ichaphazelo P elinjalo ukuze indawo kanxantathu ABP ibe yi-12cm², yaye ii-coordinates zika-P zingamanani aphelele.
y-m-26-05.thinking.0: Ukufumana izisombululo ezininzi ezanelisa iimfuno ngaxeshanye
y-m-26-05.thinking.1: Ukuqonda indawo (imo) apho amachaphazelo alele khona
y-m-26-05.prereq.0: Indawo kanxantathu = isiseko × ubude ÷ 2 (inqanaba lebanga 5 lesikolo samabanga aphantsi)
y-m-26-05.prereq.1: Indawo yamachaphazelo kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa, nentsingiselo ye-engile ebukhali, ethe nkqo nebuthuntu
y-m-26-05.prereq.2: Ukuba imigca emibini ihambelana, umgama phakathi kwayo uhleli ufana (umgama phakathi kwemigca ehambelanayo)
y-m-26-05.s.s1.prompt: Kwisicwangciso sokulungelelanisa kukho u-A(0, 0) no-B(6, 0). Ufuna ichaphazelo P libe ngaphezulu kwe-x-axis yaye indawo kanxantathu ABP ibe yi-12cm². Ungaba nemo enjani ukuba uqokelela onke amachaphazelo P anjalo? (Ikwere enye i-1cm)
y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.0: Cinga ukuba ubude kufuneka bube mde kangakanani ukuze indawo ibe yi-12 xa ubona u-AB njengesiseko sikanxantathu ABP.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.hint.1: Xa uhambisa u-P phezulu naphantsi ngokuthe nkqo ku-AB, cinga ngamacala onokuhamba kuwo ngoxa ugcina ubude obufanayo.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.a: Amachaphazelo kwisetyhula anomgama ohleli ungatshintshi ukusuka ku-A
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.a: Nokuba amachaphazelo asesetyhulweni anomgama ofanayo ukusuka ku-A, umgama wawo ukusuka ku-AB (ubude) uyahluka.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.b: Ichaphazelo elinye kuphela. Xa indawo imiselwe ibe yi-12, P imiselwe ibe yinye
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukuba nesiseko esifanayo kunye nendawo efanayo kuthetha ukuba nobude obufanayo. Ingaba likho ichaphazelo elinye kuphela elinobude obufanayo?
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.c: Amachaphazelo kumgca odlula embindini wa-AB yaye uthe nkqo ku-AB
y-m-26-05.s.s1.r.c: Amachaphazelo akulo mgca anemigama eyahlukileyo ukusuka ku-AB, ngoko ubude buyahluka. Iindawo ziba ngezahlukileyo omnye komnye.
y-m-26-05.s.s1.o.d: Amachaphazelo kumgca ohambelana no-AB yaye ungama-4cm ukusuka ku-AB
y-m-26-05.s.s1.explain: Isiseko AB = 6cm sifanayo, ngoko ukuze indawo ibe yi-12cm², ubude kufuneka babe yi-12 × 2 ÷ 6 = 4cm. Amachaphazelo akubude be-4cm ukusuka ku-AB onke ngamachaphazelo akumgca ohambelana no-AB (y = 4).
y-m-26-05.s.s2.prompt: Fumana amachaphazelo ama-3 ahlukeneyo P apho indawo kanxantathu ABP iyi-12cm² yaye zonke ii-engile ezintathu zibukhali (ii-engile ezincinci kuno-90°). Ii-coordinates zika-P zingamanani aphelele.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.hint.0: Phakathi kwamachaphazelo akumgca owufumeneyo kwinyathelo langaphambili, tshintsha i-x-coordinate enye ngexesha uze uhlole ukuba ii-engile zibukhali na.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.hint.1: Zoba oko kwenzeka kwii-engile kumachaphazelo A no-B xa i-x-coordinate incinci kakhulu okanye inkulu kakhulu.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.ok.c1: P lichaphazelo elineecoordinates ezingamanani aphelele ngaphezulu kwe-x-axis.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c1: P kufuneka libe ngaphezulu kwe-x-axis (y>0) yaye libe nee-coordinates ezingamanani aphelele.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c2: Indawo kanxantathu ABP ayiyi-12cm². Hlola kwakhona isiseko AB nobude.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.fail.c3: Enye yee-engile ezintathu yi-engile ethe nkqo okanye ebuthuntu. Hlola ii-engile kumachaphazelo A, B, no-P omnye emva komnye.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.explain: Ukuba P yi-(1, 4), (2, 4), (3, 4), (4, 4), (5, 4), zonke zinobude be-4cm ngoko indawo yi-12. Ukuba i-x-coordinate ngu-0 okanye 6, kukho i-engile ethe nkqo ku-A okanye ku-B, yaye ngaphandle koko ibuthuntu. Ngoko ezi zihlanu ngamachaphazelo aphelele kuphela. Ichaphazelo (3, 4) linika unxantathu olinganayo ngamacala amabini, yaye ezinye ngoonxantathu bemo ezahlukeneyo.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.prompt: Thelekisa amachaphazelo owafumeneyo. Cacisa isizathu sokuba iindawo zifane nangona imo kanxantathu yahlukile kwichaphazelo ngalinye, nendlela imeko ye-engile ebukhali ecinezele ngayo iindawo zamachaphazelo.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.hint.0: Thelekisa ii-y-coordinates zamachaphazelo owafumeneyo uze uthi akumgca muni.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.hint.1: Zoba ukuba ii-engile kumachaphazelo A no-B ziziidigri ezingaphi xa i-x-coordinate ka-P ingu-0 nalapho ingu-6.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ingaba ucacise isizathu sokuba iindawo zifane ngokuthi 'isiseko sifanayo yaye ubude bufanayo nabo'?
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ingaba ucacise ngee-engile isizathu sokuba ayisebenzi xa i-x-coordinate ingu-0, 6, okanye ingaphandle?
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.model.0: Amachaphazelo akumgca ohambelana no-AB, ngoko ubona u-AB njengesiseko, ubude bonke bufanayo be-4, yaye isiseko sifanayo se-6, ngoko iindawo zonke zi-12. Ukuba i-x-coordinate ngu-0 okanye 6, kukho i-engile ethe nkqo ku-A okanye ku-B, yaye ukuba incinci kuno-0 okanye ingaphezulu kwe-6 ibuthuntu, ngoko u-1 ukuya ku-5 kuphela kusebenza.
y-m-26-05.s.s2.because.model.1: Isiseko AB si-6 yaye ubude bufanayo be-4, ngoko nangona imo ziyahluka iindawo ziyafana. Ii-engile kufuneka zibukhali, ngoko P akufanele libe ngqo phezu kwa-A okanye B okanye ngaphandle kwazo, yaye i-x-coordinate kufuneka ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-6.
